en: Abu al-Walid Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Rushd
tr: Ebü'l-Velîd Muhammed b. Ahmed İbn Rüşd
ar: أبو الوليد محمد بن أحمد ابن رشد

description.tr: 'Şârih' — Aristoteles şerhleri o kadar otoriteydi ki Avrupalı filozoflar ona basitçe 'Şârih' dediler. Akılcı felsefeyi hem İslam hem Hristiyan medeniyetleri için kurtardı || İbn Rüşd'ün 38 Aristoteles şerhi (kısa, orta ve uzun), ortaçağ Avrupa'sının Aristoteles felsefesini aldığı araçtı. Paris'teki Latin Averroizm hareketi 1270 ve 1277 Kınamaları'nı kışkırttı. || [Tarih notu] Renan'ın Averroès et l'Averroïsme (1852) eseri İbn Rüşd'ü Yunan ve Avrupa felsefesi arasındaki köprü olarak belirledi.
description.en: The 'Commentator' — his Aristotle commentaries were so authoritative that European philosophers simply called him 'the Commentator.' Saved rationalist philosophy for both Islamic and Christian civilizations || Ibn Rushd's 38 Aristotle commentaries (short, middle, and long) were the vehicle through which medieval Europe received Aristotelian philosophy. The Latin Averroist movement at Paris provoked the Condemnations of 1270 and 1277 — ironically, these condemnations forced philosophers to develop new approaches that contributed to the Scientific Revolution. His 'double truth' theory (though likely a misattribution) catalyzed the separation of philosophy from theology. || [Historiographical note] Renan's Averroès et l'Averroïsme (1852) established the narrative of Averroes as the bridge between Greek and European philosophy. Urvoy (1991) and Taylor (2005) have complicated this picture by emphasizing Ibn Rushd's Islamic context and original contributions beyond mere commentary.
description.ar: الشارح — شروحه على أرسطو كانت حجّة لدرجة أن الفلاسفة الأوروبيين سمّوه ببساطة 'الشارح' || شروح ابن رشد الثمانية والثلاثون على أرسطو كانت الوسيلة التي تلقت بها أوروبا الوسطى الفلسفة الأرسطية. حركة الرشدية اللاتينية أثارت إدانات ١٢٧٠ و١٢٧٧
